testCase:
H-16: Reorder by dragging
Goal: Reorder the list so that it reads Deploy, Build, Test.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/h-16/
STEP 2: Drag "Deploy" above "Build"
STEP 3: Verify "Order: Deploy, Build, Test" is visible

steps.note: Verify the requested list order is visible.

reasoning: This test checks that dragging Deploy above Build reorders the list to Deploy, Build, Test. The plan follows the specified navigation and drag, then asserts the exact visible order text.
